/ai-landing-page-builder/landing-page-se.note: [truth | HUB_RULES 8] feature_5: Escalated from reviewer-batch-m1's note because it is untrue, not merely imprecise. Organic search clicks carry no UTM tags, so filtering a form's UTM field separates tagged paid leads from every untagged lead: direct, referral, email and organic together. The cited source (support.google.com/analytics/answer/10917952) gives utm_medium naming advice ('one unique utm_medium for each distinct channel'). It does not say UTM tags identify organic visits; GA4 does that from the referrer, which this form does not record. The title 'Leads saved with their landing URL' also no longer matches the body. -> "...then filter on utm_medium to separate paid leads from the rest." Or record the referrer as well and say leads referred by a search engine are organic. Bring the title and body back to the same point. | [truth | HUB_RULES 8] faq item 5: Escalated from the reviewer-c5-seo and reviewer-batch-m1 note.
